tasks.title: Project setup and packaging
tasks.description: Create pyproject.toml with Click and tabulate dependencies, src/tracker/ package structure, and pytest configuration. Define 'tracker' CLI entry point.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: pyproject.toml defines project with click, tabulate, pytest dependencies
AC-2: 'tracker' entry point is defined and installable via pip install -e .
GATE: pip install -e . succeeds and 'tracker --help' shows usage

tasks.title: Database module with schema initialization
tasks.description: Create database.py with SQLite connection management and auto-schema creation (tasks, tags, task_tags, time_entries tables). DB path defaults to ~/.tracker/tracker.db, configurable via TRACKER_DB_PATH.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Creates ~/.tracker/ directory and tracker.db on first run
AC-2: All 4 tables created with correct schema and foreign keys
AC-3: TRACKER_DB_PATH env var overrides default location
GATE: python -c 'from tracker.database import get_connection' runs without error

tasks.title: Data models
tasks.description: Create models.py with Python dataclasses for Task, Tag, TimeEntry. Include helper methods for time duration calculation.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Task, Tag, TimeEntry dataclasses defined with all fields from schema
AC-2: TimeEntry has duration property that calculates elapsed time
GATE: Models importable and instantiable

tasks.title: Repository layer
tasks.description: Create repository.py with CRUD operations: create/find tasks by name, create/find tags, link tags to tasks, create/close time entries, query active entry, query entries by date range and tags.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Can create and find tasks by name (reuse existing)
AC-2: Can create tags and link/unlink to tasks (many-to-many)
AC-3: Can create time entries and close active entry (set end_time)
AC-4: Can query entries filtered by date range and/or tags
AC-5: INV-4 enforced: only one open time entry at a time
GATE: All repository methods work against in-memory SQLite

tasks.title: Service layer with business logic
tasks.description: Create service.py implementing: start_task (auto-pause active), stop_task, resume_task, add_tags, get_report (daily + filtered), list_tasks. Enforces BR-1 through BR-4.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: start_task auto-pauses any active task before starting new one (BR-1)
AC-2: resume_task creates new time entry for existing task (BR-3)
AC-3: get_report aggregates time from all entries per task (BR-2)
AC-4: list_tasks returns tasks with status and accumulated time
GATE: Service methods work correctly via unit tests

tasks.title: CLI commands with Click
tasks.description: Create cli.py with Click group and subcommands: start, stop, resume, list, report, tag. Wire commands to service layer. Handle user input validation and error display.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: 'tracker start "name" --tag X' starts task with tags
AC-2: 'tracker stop' pauses active task
AC-3: 'tracker resume' shows paused tasks for selection
AC-4: 'tracker list' shows all tasks with status
AC-5: 'tracker report' with --from, --to, --tag filters
AC-6: 'tracker tag TASK_ID --add TAG' adds tag to existing task
GATE: tracker --help shows all commands

tasks.title: Report formatting with tabulate
tasks.description: Create formatting.py with functions to format report data as aligned terminal tables. Show task name, tags, total time (HH:MM:SS), percentage. Grand total row at bottom.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Report table shows columns: Task, Tags, Time, Percentage
AC-2: Time displayed as HH:MM:SS format
AC-3: Tasks sorted by total time descending
AC-4: Grand total row at bottom
GATE: Formatted output is readable in terminal

tasks.title: Unit tests for service and repository
tasks.description: Create test_service.py and test_repository.py with pytest. Use in-memory SQLite via conftest.py fixtures. Cover: start/stop/resume flows, tag operations, report queries, edge cases (duplicate tasks, no active task).
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: conftest.py provides in-memory SQLite fixture
AC-2: Service tests cover start, stop, resume, report, list flows
AC-3: Repository tests cover CRUD and query operations
AC-4: Edge cases: stop with no active task, resume with no paused tasks
GATE: pytest passes with 80%+ coverage on service and repository

tasks.title: Integration tests for CLI commands
tasks.description: Create test_cli.py using Click's CliRunner. Test full command flows: start → switch → resume → report. Verify output formatting and error messages.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Full lifecycle test: start → start another → resume → stop → report
AC-2: Tag operations tested via CLI
AC-3: Error cases: invalid commands, missing arguments
AC-4: Report filters tested: --from, --to, --tag
GATE: pytest passes all CLI integration tests

tasks.title: Code review
tasks.description: Run code review using meli-code-reviewer. Check code quality, naming conventions, error handling, and adherence to specs.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: No critical issues found by meli-code-reviewer
GATE: Code review passes

tasks.title: Performance review
tasks.description: Run performance review using meli-performance-expert. Check for N+1 queries, inefficient algorithms, and SQLite query optimization.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: No N+1 query patterns detected
AC-2: SQLite indexes verified for report queries
GATE: Performance review passes

tasks.title: Security review
tasks.description: Run security review using meli-security-expert. Check for SQL injection, file permission issues, and input validation.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: No SQL injection vulnerabilities (parameterized queries used)
AC-2: Database file created with restrictive permissions
GATE: Security review passes
